missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Начальство' is nominative as the subject of 'приняло'. This neuter collective noun takes a neuter singular verb, and 'решение' is the accusative object.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Начальство' is the accusative object here. As a neuter noun its accusative matches the nominative. 'Местное' is the agreeing neuter adjective.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Начальства' is genitive after 'от' to show the source of the answer. 'Ответа' is the genitive object of 'ждём'.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 'Начальству' is the dative indirect object, the party that received the complaint. 'Рабочие' is the nominative plural subject.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after adjective. 'Начальством' is the instrumental governed by 'доволен', which always takes the instrumental for what one is satisfied with.
Strategic focus: Prepositional topic. 'Начальстве' uses the prepositional form after 'о' to mark the topic of the report. 'В отчёте' adds the location.
Strategic focus: Nominative description. 'Начальство' is nominative as the subject. 'Новое' and 'строгое' are agreeing neuter adjectives, intensified by 'очень'.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Начальства' is genitive linking to 'решение' to mean the decision of the authorities. 'Всех' is the animate accusative object.

missions.phrase: Я иду на встречу с начальством.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Instrumental after preposition. 'Начальством' takes the instrumental after 'с' to mean with the authorities. 'На встречу' is the accusative destination.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'Начальству' takes the dative after 'к' to mean reaching the authorities. 'Трудно' is the impersonal predicate.
